camel_example: aliyun cloudfw CreateTrFirewallV2 --region cn-hangzhou --RouteMode managed --RegionNo 'cn-hangzhou' --FirewallDescription 'vpc-firewall-description' --TrAttachmentMasterZone 'cn-chengdu-a' --FirewallVpcId 'vpc-wz9r5qvryn0lg3atb0000' --FirewallSubnetCidr '10.0.1.0/24' --Lang zh --FirewallServiceMode PrimaryStandby --FirewallVpcCidr '10.0.0.0/16' --TrAttachmentZones.1 'cn-hangzhou-h' --FirewallAttachmentZone 'cn-hangzhou-h' --FirewallServiceZones.1 'cn-hangzhou-i' --FirewallName 'vpc-firewall-test' --TrAttachmentMasterCidr '10.0.3.0/24' --FirewallVswitchId 'vsw-uf6ydz3vqj77mr5l60000' --CenId 'cen-4xbjup276au29r0000' --TrAttachmentSlaveCidr '10.0.0.16/28' --TrAttachmentSlaveZone 'cn-chengdu-b' --TransitRouterId 'tr-m5etmb2q7e0mxcur0000'
description_en: Creates a VPC firewall for a transit router. Before you begin: (1) Purchase Cloud Firewall. (2) Create a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance and enable an Enterprise Edition forwarding router. (3) Synchronize the transit router to Cloud Firewall
description_zh: 创建TR防火墙。【前置条件】(1) 已购买云防火墙服务；(2) 已创建 CEN 实例并启用企业版转发路由器；(3) TR 已同步到云防火墙
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw create-tr-firewall-v2 --lang zh --firewall-name vpc-firewall-test --route-mode managed --transit-router-id tr-m5etmb2q7e0mxcur0000 --region-no cn-hangzhou --firewall-vpc-cidr 10.0.0.0/16 --firewall-subnet-cidr 10.0.1.0/24 --tr-attachment-slave-cidr 10.0.0.16/28 --tr-attachment-master-cidr 10.0.3.0/24 --cen-id cen-4xbjup276au29r0000 --firewall-description vpc-firewall-description --firewall-vpc-id vpc-wz9r5qvryn0lg3atb0000 --firewall-vswitch-id vsw-uf6ydz3vqj77mr5l60000 --tr-attachment-slave-zone cn-chengdu-b --tr-attachment-master-zone cn-chengdu-a --tr-attachment-zones cn-hangzhou-h --firewall-attachment-zone cn-hangzhou-h --firewall-service-mode PrimaryStandby --firewall-service-zones cn-hangzhou-i --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTrFirewallV2

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The name of the Cloud Firewall instance
parameters.name: firewall_name

parameters.help_en: The routing mode. This parameter is required. Valid values: managed (automatic mode) and manual (manual mode). In managed mode, you must specify FirewallVpcCidr, FirewallSubnetCidr, TrAttachmentSlaveCidr, and TrAttachmentMasterCidr. In manual mode, you must specify FirewallVpcId, FirewallVswitchId, TrAttachmentSlaveZone, and TrAttachmentMasterZone
parameters.help_zh: 路由模式。本参数必填。取值：managed（自动模式）或 manual（手动模式）。managed 模式需提供 FirewallVpcCidr、FirewallSubnetCidr、TrAttachmentSlaveCidr 和 TrAttachmentMasterCidr；manual 模式需提供 FirewallVpcId、FirewallVswitchId、TrAttachmentSlaveZone 和 TrAttachmentMasterZone
parameters.name: route_mode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router instance. This parameter is required. The transit router must belong to the CEN instance specified by CenId
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例 ID。本参数必填，且该转发路由器必须属于 CenId 指定的云企业网实例
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router. This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器所在地域 ID。本参数必填
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The CIDR block of the firewall VPC in automatic mode
parameters.help_zh: 自动模式下防火墙VPC网段
parameters.name: firewall_vpc_cidr

parameters.help_en: The subnet CIDR block used to store the firewall ENI in the firewall VPC in automatic mode
parameters.help_zh: 自动模式下防火墙VPC中存放防火墙ENI的子网网段
parameters.name: firewall_subnet_cidr

parameters.help_en: The secondary subnet CIDR block used to connect to the TR in the firewall VPC in automatic mode
parameters.help_zh: 自动模式下防火墙VPC中用于连接TR的子网备用网段
parameters.name: tr_attachment_slave_cidr

parameters.help_en: The primary subnet CIDR block used to connect to the TR in the firewall VPC in automatic mode
parameters.help_zh: 自动模式下防火墙VPC中用于连接TR的子网主用网段
parameters.name: tr_attachment_master_cidr

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance. This parameter is required. Create a CEN instance in the CEN console before calling this operation, and ensure that an Enterprise Edition transit router has been created
parameters.help_zh: 云企业网实例 ID。本参数必填；请先在 CEN 产品中创建云企业网实例，并确保已创建企业版转发路由器
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC in which the firewall ENI is created in manual mode
parameters.help_zh: 手动模式下创建防火墙ENI的VPC ID
parameters.name: firewall_vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in which the firewall ENI is created in manual mode
parameters.help_zh: 手动模式下创建防火墙ENI的VSW ID
parameters.name: firewall_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The secondary zone of the vSwitch
parameters.name: tr_attachment_slave_zone

parameters.help_en: The primary zone of the vSwitch
parameters.name: tr_attachment_master_zone

parameters.help_en: The list of zone IDs used by the TR connection
parameters.help_zh: TR 连接使用的可用区 ID 列表
parameters.name: tr_attachment_zones

parameters.help_en: The zone ID used by the firewall connection
parameters.help_zh: 防火墙连接使用的可用区 ID
parameters.name: firewall_attachment_zone

parameters.help_en:
The deployment mode of the firewall service. Valid values:

PrimaryStandby: Primary/standby mode.
MultiPrimary: Active-active mode.

If this parameter is not specified, the system automatically selects a deployment mode based on the capabilities of the transit router. If an invalid value is specified, the error ErrorFwServiceMode (-360437) is returned. MultiPrimary mode does not support specifying zones
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙服务部署模式。取值：

PrimaryStandby：主备模式
MultiPrimary：双活模式

不传该参数时，由系统按转发路由器的能力自动选择部署模式；取值非法时返回 ErrorFwServiceMode（-360437）。MultiPrimary 模式不支持指定可用区
parameters.name: firewall_service_mode

parameters.help_en: The list of zone IDs used by the firewall service
parameters.help_zh: 防火墙服务使用的可用区 ID 列表
parameters.name: firewall_service_zones

FirewallId.description_en: The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall
